name: list_deployment_files
description:
List the file tree of a deployment's source code by deployment ID. A file tree is available only for deployments created with the Vercel CLI or the API with the `files` key.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v6/deployments/{id}/files --method GET. Fill placeholders from inputs.

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
